name: Marienmünster (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Marienmünster (a red church with a star on white).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 25 July 1973 the city of Marienmünster was granted the right to bear arms, a flag and a banner; the flag is red and white striped with the city arms shifted from the centre towards the staff.

features.role: Marienmünster arms — red church with star on white
